# The Radiant Hotel & Resort

> Luxury hospitality, fine dining, celebrations, and wellness in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Overview
[The Radiant Hotel & Resort](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/) is a premier luxury hospitality destination located in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. The property features curated room suites, rooftop lounge dining, authentic Vedic wellness treatments, expansive banquet halls, and modern fitness facilities.

## Accommodation & Suites
- [Rooms & Suites Collection](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/rooms): Explore luxury rooms and suites in Gorakhpur.
- [Deluxe Room (Pool View & Balcony)](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/rooms): 450 sq ft private sanctuary with private balcony and king bed.
- [Executive Room](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/rooms): 550 sq ft corporate luxury with dedicated work salon.
- [Executive Suite](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/rooms): 720 sq ft suite with separate living parlor and premium finishes.
- [Grandeur Suite](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/rooms): 980 sq ft presidential-tier luxury with private pool verandah.
- [Standard Room](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/rooms): Elegant, comfortable accommodation designed for refined short stays.

## Culinary & Nightlife
- [The Seven Scentric Fine Dining](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/dining): Fine dining restaurant featuring Awadhi, North Indian, Pan-Asian, and Continental culinary masterpieces.
- [Malibu Rooftop Lounge](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/malibu): 84-meter-high open-air rooftop lounge offering sunset views, craft mixology, acoustic sessions, and celebration beats.

## Wellness & Spa
- [Vedic Spa & Salon](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/wellness): Holistic wellness center offering traditional Ayurvedic massage, Shirodhara, Basalt stone therapy, Moroccan Argan rituals, and organic saffron facials.

## Banquets & Celebrations
- [Imperial Banquets & Royal Lawns](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/banquet): Expansive pillarless banquet hall accommodating up to 1,200+ guests for weddings, galas, and corporate conferences.
- [Royal Celebration Lawns](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/banquet): Landscaped open-air gardens for starlit weddings and landmark celebrations.

## Location & Contact
- Address: Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Website: [https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/)
